qualification: x86 virtio MMIO and private IOAPIC adapter component

assertions: Bounded RAM binding and guest-only device aperture
Register width/alignment rejection and configuration subword extraction
Queue GPA mapping through the shared libvmm register core
IOAPIC level persistence through EOI until device acknowledgement
Device reset lowers its interrupt without lowering another device's line
Host ASan/UBSan execution and real x86 SDK adapter compilation

tests.scope: Host suite including adapter, SDK backend/adapter compilation, both root-task boots, AArch64 guest net/block/bidirectional console

limitations: The adapter is not yet linked into firmware VM-exit dispatch or advertised to an Intel guest.
Canonical service topology, notification handling and Intel target I/O remain unqualified.
This adapter admits one boot vCPU and contiguous GPA-zero RAM below the MMIO aperture; sparse high RAM and teardown/rebinding need separate integration.
